steps.name: candidate-identity
steps.command: git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller && git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "100a7c9d618586b8b7c0add27084763261bee238" && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo QUALITY_FREEZE_IDENTITY_PASS sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD) hardware_started=0

steps.name: architecture-guards
steps.command: .venv/bin/python scripts/check_output_rf_ownership.py && git diff --check && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo QUALITY_FREEZE_ARCHITECTURE_PASS hardware_started=0

verify_steps.name: full-quality-gate
verify_steps.command: bash scripts/quality_gate_push.sh && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo QUALITY_FREEZE_FULL_PASS sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD) hardware_started=0
